mapper.select: SELECT C.CONSULT_ID AS consultId, C.CUST_ID AS custId, C.CONSULT_TYPE AS consultType, CC.CODE_NAME AS consultTypeName, C.CONTENT AS content, C.CREATOR_ID AS creatorId, U.USER_NAME AS creatorName, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, C.USE_YN AS useYn FROM TB_CUST_CONSULT C LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = C.CREATOR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE CC ON CC.GROUP_CODE = 'CONSULT_TYPE' AND CC.CODE_VALUE = C.CONSULT_TYPE AND (CC.USE_YN IS NULL OR CC.USE_YN = 'Y') WHERE C.CUST_ID = #{custId} AND (C.USE_YN IS NULL OR C.USE_YN = 'Y') ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CUST_CONSULT (CUST_ID, CONSULT_TYPE, CONTENT, CREATOR_ID, USE_YN) VALUES (#{custId}, #{consultType}, #{content}, #{creatorId}, 'Y')
